# Liv Hospital

> Liv Hospital is a multi-location international healthcare network offering advanced medical treatments, specialized clinical services, and cutting-edge surgical technologies across Turkey, Azerbaijan, and Hungary.

Liv Hospital operates a network of medical centers including locations in Istanbul (Ulus, Vadistanbul, Topkapı, Bahçeşehir), Baku, and Budapest. The organization emphasizes advanced medical technologies, specialized clinical departments, and patient-centered care with a focus on robotic surgery, cancer treatment, and preventive health screening.

## Key Topics

- Robotic Surgery (da Vinci)
- Cancer Treatment & Oncology
- Minimally Invasive Surgery
- Stem Cell Therapy
- Medical Technologies (MRI, Ultrasound)
- Thoracic Surgery
- Interventional Cardiology
- Gastroenterology
- Neurology
- Orthopedics
- Full-Body Health Screening
- Hospital Network Locations
- Clinical Departments
- Physician Directory
- Patient Education

- [Orthopedics - Liv Hospital](https://int.livhospital.com/orthopedics): Orthopedics overview covering bone, joint health, and musculoskeletal conditions.
